subject: Behavior of package loading on shiny server: will it be loaded only once or everytime?

messages.author: 8f8f51bd41e07a5d
messages.subject: Behavior of package loading on shiny server: will it be loaded only once or everytime?
parts:
Hi everyone, I have a question about the shiny server.

Suppose I have a shiny app which has several giant packages to be loaded and it is hosted on my shiny server. One user opened the page and leaved; then after a while, a second user dropped in, will the packages be loaded again or the previous r session can retain?

The reason I ask about this is that I have some data to be loaded from disk and processed in my shiny app, which takes some waiting time. Thus I consider to wrap the preprocessed R data into a package and load the package instead. Or there might be a better practice to handle this？

Thanks in advance!
